result:
I fixed F-DG2-150 and the API side of F-DG2-143. One part of F-DG2-143 is still open: a slow web test sits in `apps/web/**`, which I wasn't allowed to change. Every required check passed, with the `format:check` caveat below. The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/T-DG2-BE4-backend-workflow-engineer.md`. I added no migrations, no API endpoints and no contract changes.

**F-DG2-150 (the exclusions pre-check now fails)**
- **Fix:** in `charter.ts`, an empty, null or blank Out of scope now gives `attention` with the required detail text. It gives `pass` only when the trimmed text is non-empty, and it never returns `unknown` on a saved charter.
- **Second reader:** the G1 "initial charter" criterion (`g1.initial_charter` in `workflows/criteria.ts`) also checked Out of scope, and it counted whitespace-only text as filled in. It now uses the same rule, so the pre-check and G1 readiness agree.
- **ADR-0017 §2:** updated, citing B0041 and REQ-PB-031 A01.
- **Tests:** the old `registers.test.ts` assertion now expects `attention`. The four regression cases you specified are in a new block against a real PostgreSQL: empty, whitespace-only, real text, then cleared again with If-Match. The block also checks that a stale If-Match gets 409, the audit trail, and the G1 consistency. There is also a new unit test, `exclusions.test.ts`.

**F-DG2-143 (the flaky architecture test)**
- **Fix:** the architecture boundary test, the package-direction tests and the five per-module boundary tests now have an explicit 30 s timeout, each with a comment citing F-DG2-143. I didn't raise the global default.
- **Not made cheaper, on purpose:**
  - No two of these tests parse the same files, so there's nothing to share.
  - The other possible saving would weaken the syntax check that F-DG1-137/217/218 hardened. Details are in the handback.
- **Unit tests slower than 2.5 s:** only one, in the web suite: `transformations.test.tsx` "a failed /me refresh never blocks the navigation…", at about 3.2 s against a 5 s timeout. It needs explicit headroom, but it's under `apps/web/**`, so I left it open for the frontend owner.
- **Slowest API unit test:** the architecture boundary test, at about 1.9 s under full load.

**Checks run**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm -r typecheck` and `pnpm -r build` | Both exit 0 on the second run. The first run failed in `apps/web` while the frontend agent was editing it; the assignment allows one re-run. |
| `pnpm lint` | Exit 0 |
| `pnpm openapi:lint` | Exit 0, 161 operations |
| `pnpm format:check` | Exit 2: Prettier can't read sandbox-masked files that aren't part of the repo (`CLAUDE.local.md`, `.zshrc` and similar). With those excluded, it exits 0. |
| `pnpm test`, Node 24.21.0 and Node 22.22.2 | 504/504 on each. Node 22 is at `/opt/node22/bin`, not the nvm path. |
| Integration suite, disposable PostgreSQL 16 on port 55471 | 444/444, including `registers.test.ts` and `contract.test.ts` |
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG1` | `PASS gate DG1 (historical)` |

**Other open items (listed in the handback)**
- **Web test fixture:** `p2fixtures.ts` still shows this check as `unknown`. That's frontend scope.
- **Same blank-text problem elsewhere:** the other required charter fields in the G1 check, such as In scope, still count whitespace-only text as filled in. That's outside F-DG2-150, so I left them unchanged.
